entity.name: Seenu K
entity.description: India-based maintainer of OpenSplit, working under EigenInteractive, a brand of the sole proprietorship Seenu K Labs. Funding is earmarked for OpenSplit, including maintainer time.

projects.name: OpenSplit
projects.description: A local-first expense splitter available on Google Play and the web, with offline expense recording, balances kept separately by currency and CSV export. Functionality remains free, with no ads, analytics SDKs or data sale. The backend depends on Cloudflare and currently has no self-hosting path.

channels.description: One-time INR contributions to OpenSplit through Seenu K Labs. UPI is available.
EigenInteractive’s GitHub Sponsors profile features OpenSplit. Sponsorship through this profile supports OpenSplit.
Separate Razorpay subscription checkout for INR. Public enrollment and cancellation have yet to be configured and verified.
Seenu K Labs’ Buy Me a Coffee page. Contributions referred from OpenSplit are earmarked for the project. The checkout may display localized prices.
One-time and monthly tips through the Seenu K Labs Ko-fi profile. International payments are processed through PayPal.
Seenu K Labs’ Liberapay profile supports OpenSplit and other open-source projects. PayPal donors confirm each renewal.

plans.name: One-time community support in INR
plans.description: Choose a one-time INR amount through the hosted OpenSplit Payment Page. Suggested amounts are INR 100, 500 or 1500.

plans.name: Monthly community support in INR
plans.description: Monthly INR support is planned. Activation requires a verified enrollment and cancellation flow.

plans.name: One-time community support in USD
plans.description: Choose a one-time USD amount through one of the listed providers. On Liberapay, stop renewals after the first payment.

plans.name: Monthly community support in USD
plans.description: Choose a monthly USD amount through one of the listed providers. PayPal donors on Liberapay confirm each renewal.

plans.name: One-time support on Buy Me a Coffee

plans.name: Monthly support on Buy Me a Coffee

plans.name: Yearly support on Buy Me a Coffee
plans.description: The Supporter membership is USD 50 per year at the base price. The checkout may display localized prices.
